title: GDPR PII/OII Filtering for Telemetry
body:
The following data fields should not be reported in Telemetry without explicit enabling by the developer

|Property|`EventString`|Notes|
|---|---|---|
|Subject|   |Not tracked by telemetry|
|UPN|   |Not tracked by telemetry|
|Given Name|   |Not tracked by telemetry|
|Family Name|   |Not tracked by telemetry|
|Email|   |Not tracked by telemetry|
|OID|   |Not tracked by telemetry|
|Login Hint|`LOGIN_HINT`|   |
|Home OID|   |Not tracked by telemetry|
|Exception traces containing network responses|   |    |
|AT/RT/IdToken|`USER_ID`|   |
|Tenant Id|`TENANT_ID`|   |
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
